body:
The orchestrator's second resume in a session now shows only what moved since its last one (steps, sessions, questions, your comments, other writers), or a single line when nothing did. It stays current before answering you without rereading the whole board; the whole board is still one flag away.

### How it works
- `kit.py resume` (and `--role orchestrator`) saves what it read in `.kit/run/resume/<role>-<session>.json`: per post its status, column, session and last update; per comment who wrote it and what; his unanswered comments; the running sessions.
- The next resume of the same session compares and prints only the differences, under five headings: Steps, Sessions, Questions, The owner's comments, Other writers (comments of reviewers and parts, `_trains` and other kit posts). With nothing new: `Resume: nothing new since HH:MM UTC (the whole: kit.py resume --role orchestrator --full)`.
- Each resume becomes the new reference, so a third shows only what changed since the second.

### When it is whole
- The first resume of a session (no state file), `--full`, a takeover (another session id), a hand-over (`.kit/handover-<role>.gen` changed, even under the same CLI session name), after a compaction (`kit_session_start.py` deletes the session's file on `source: compact|clear`), with no session id at all, and for the part, review and clerk roles (their resume is their prompt).

### The guard
- `kit_brief_guard.py` already stamps any `kit.py resume` that exits 0; a delta exits 0, so it counts as fresh. Its docstring says so, and a test sends a delta read through the hook and then a reply that passes.

### Also fixed
- `scripts/run_all_tests.py --list --all` printed "full run not saved on a commit" on an uncommitted tree, which `tests/test_run_all_tests.py` read as a suite (an earlier WIP commit, 568b8f5, said it was untested): it is no longer printed with `--list`.
- The full suite failed on the device gate tests whenever it ran through the runner: the gate counted the memory the test run itself had reserved. The runner now gives its suites an empty jobs folder (`KIT_JOBS_DIR`), and the device and guard cap tests read an empty one too. 69 of 69 suites pass.
handoff: `kit.py resume_delta(m, role, session, ...)` returns the delta text or None (print whole) and saves the session's snapshot in .kit/run/resume/<role>-<session>.json; a hand-over is detected by .kit/handover-<role>.gen changing, a compaction deletes the file (kit_session_start.py). M6's ledger can count resume characters per call from there.
not_checked: the dry run on anlonlt/harmonize (the orchestrator's, from its session: `real_project`)
agy: its hooks send no SessionStart `source`, so a compaction there does not clear the delta state (agy hands over before compacting)
